mass-media.en: The mass media has a strong influence on public opinion about politics.
mass-media.zh: 大众媒体对公众的政治看法有很大影响。

media.en: The media should be free to criticise those in power.
media.zh: 媒体应该可以自由批评当权者。

press.en: A free press is essential to any healthy democracy.
press.zh: 自由的新闻界对任何健康的民主国家都必不可少。

press.en: Simply press the button to speak to a member of staff.
press.zh: 只需按下按钮,就能和工作人员通话。

journalism.en: Good journalism helps people to understand complex social problems.
journalism.zh: 好的新闻业帮助人们理解复杂的社会问题。

journalist.en: A journalist should check the facts carefully before publishing a story.
journalist.zh: 记者在发表报道前应仔细核实事实。

reporter.en: The reporter spent a year investigating conditions in the country's prisons.
reporter.zh: 这名记者花了一年时间调查该国监狱的状况。

editor.en: The editor decides which stories will appear on the front page.
editor.zh: 编辑决定哪些报道登上头版。

headline.en: A shocking headline can attract readers even when the story is unimportant.
headline.zh: 即使报道并不重要,耸人听闻的标题也能吸引读者。

coverage.en: News coverage of crime can make people feel less safe than they are.
coverage.zh: 关于犯罪的新闻报道可能让人们感觉比实际情况更不安全。

broadcast.en: Television stations should broadcast more programmes about science.
broadcast.zh: 电视台应该播放更多科学节目。

channel.en: Some people get their news from a single television channel.
channel.zh: 有些人只从一个电视频道获取新闻。

documentary.en: A good documentary can make young people care about the environment.
documentary.zh: 一部好的纪录片能让年轻人关心环境。

tabloid.en: Tabloid newspapers often focus on the private lives of famous people.
tabloid.zh: 小报常常关注名人的私生活。

broadsheet.en: A broadsheet usually offers more serious news than a popular daily paper.
broadsheet.zh: 大报通常提供比流行日报更严肃的新闻。

censorship.en: Censorship of the internet limits people's access to information.
censorship.zh: 互联网审查限制了人们获取信息。

freedom-of-speech.en: Freedom of speech does not mean that people may say anything at all.
freedom-of-speech.zh: 言论自由并不意味着人们可以说任何话。

propaganda.en: Governments have often used propaganda to win support during wars.
propaganda.zh: 政府经常在战争期间利用宣传赢得支持。

misinformation.en: Misinformation spreads quickly on the internet and can be hard to correct.
misinformation.zh: 错误信息在互联网上传播很快,而且很难纠正。

fake-news.en: Schools should teach children how to recognise fake news online.
fake-news.zh: 学校应该教孩子如何识别网上的假新闻。

sensational.en: Some newspapers publish sensational stories simply to attract more readers.
sensational.zh: 一些报纸刊登耸人听闻的报道,只是为了吸引更多读者。

biased.en: News reports may be biased in favour of those who own the media.
biased.zh: 新闻报道可能偏袒媒体的所有者。

objective-reporting.en: Objective reporting is difficult when journalists have strong political views.
objective-reporting.zh: 当记者有强烈的政治观点时,很难做到客观报道。

social-media.en: Social media makes it easy to stay in touch with friends abroad.
social-media.zh: 社交媒体让人们很容易与国外的朋友保持联系。

influencer.en: Many teenagers buy products simply because an influencer recommends them.
influencer.zh: 许多青少年买东西只是因为网红推荐。

celebrity.en: Young people are often too interested in the lives of celebrities.
celebrity.zh: 年轻人常常对名人的生活过于感兴趣。

paparazzi.en: The paparazzi follow famous people everywhere in search of photographs.
paparazzi.zh: 狗仔队到处跟踪名人,想要拍照。

intrusion.en: Publishing private photographs is a serious intrusion into a person's life.
intrusion.zh: 发布私人照片是对个人生活的严重侵扰。

addiction.en: Internet addiction can seriously affect the health of young people.
addiction.zh: 网瘾可能严重影响年轻人的健康。

addicted.en: Many children have become addicted to computer games and social media.
addicted.zh: 许多孩子沉迷于电脑游戏和社交媒体。

screen-time.en: Parents should limit the screen time of their young children.
screen-time.zh: 父母应该限制年幼孩子的屏幕使用时间。

digital-divide.en: The digital divide leaves poorer families without the same access to information.
digital-divide.zh: 数字鸿沟使较贫困家庭无法同样获取信息。

information-overload.en: Information overload makes it harder for people to concentrate on one task.
information-overload.zh: 信息过载使人们更难专注于一项任务。

connectivity.en: Better connectivity allows people in rural areas to work from home.
connectivity.zh: 更好的网络连接让农村地区的人们可以在家工作。

instant.en: Instant messaging has reduced the amount of time people spend talking face to face.
instant.zh: 即时通讯减少了人们当面交谈的时间。

convenient.en: Online shopping is convenient, but it may harm local businesses.
convenient.zh: 网购很方便,但可能损害本地商家。

accessible.en: The internet has made higher education accessible to people in remote areas.
accessible.zh: 互联网让偏远地区的人们也能接受高等教育。

access.en: Everyone should have access to clean water and basic health care.
access.zh: 每个人都应该能获得清洁的水和基本医疗。

access.en: Students can access the library's books from any computer on the campus.
access.zh: 学生可以从校园里的任何电脑访问图书馆的书籍。

dependence.en: Our growing dependence on technology may reduce our basic skills.
dependence.zh: 我们对技术日益增长的依赖可能削弱基本技能。

isolation.en: Spending too much time online can lead to social isolation.
isolation.zh: 上网时间过长可能导致社交孤立。

face-to-face.en: Nothing can fully replace face-to-face communication between teachers and students.
face-to-face.zh: 没有什么能完全取代师生之间面对面的交流。

interpersonal.en: Too much time on phones may weaken children's interpersonal skills.
interpersonal.zh: 花太多时间在手机上可能削弱孩子的人际交往能力。

revolutionise.en: Mobile phones have revolutionised the way people communicate with each other.
revolutionise.zh: 手机彻底改变了人们相互交流的方式。

job-displacement.en: Job displacement caused by automation is a serious concern for many workers.
job-displacement.zh: 自动化造成的工作岗位被替代是许多工人严重担忧的问题。

surveillance.en: Increased surveillance may reduce crime, but it also threatens personal privacy.
surveillance.zh: 加强监控也许能减少犯罪,但也威胁个人隐私。

ethical.en: There are serious ethical questions about the use of genetic information.
ethical.zh: 基因信息的使用存在严重的道德问题。

ethics.en: Journalists have a code of ethics that they are expected to follow.
ethics.zh: 记者有一套应当遵守的伦理准则。

scandal.en: A political scandal can damage public trust in the entire government.
scandal.zh: 政治丑闻可能损害公众对整个政府的信任。

gossip.en: Many magazines are filled with gossip about the private lives of celebrities.
gossip.zh: 许多杂志充斥着有关名人私生活的八卦。

rumour.en: A false rumour can spread around the world within a few hours.
rumour.zh: 虚假的谣言可能在几小时内传遍全球。

exposure.en: Too much exposure to violent films may affect the behaviour of children.
exposure.zh: 过多接触暴力电影可能影响孩子的行为。

disclosure.en: Companies should be required to make a full disclosure of their finances.
disclosure.zh: 公司应被要求全面披露财务状况。

newsworthy.en: Editors tend to think that bad news is more newsworthy than good news.
newsworthy.zh: 编辑往往认为坏消息比好消息更有新闻价值。

fabricated.en: Readers may lose trust when a newspaper publishes a fabricated story.
fabricated.zh: 报纸刊登捏造的报道时,读者可能失去信任。

exaggerated.en: The risks of the new technology have often been exaggerated by the media.
exaggerated.zh: 媒体常常夸大这项新技术的风险。

truthful.en: Advertisements should be truthful about what a product can actually do.
truthful.zh: 广告应该如实说明产品的实际功效。

deceitful.en: Deceitful advertising can persuade people to buy things they do not need.
deceitful.zh: 欺骗性广告可能诱使人们购买不需要的东西。

hypocritical.en: It seems hypocritical for rich countries to criticise the emissions of poorer ones.
hypocritical.zh: 富国批评穷国的排放,似乎很虚伪。

objectivity.en: The objectivity of the report was questioned because of who paid for it.
objectivity.zh: 由于资助方的身份,这份报告的客观性受到质疑。

readability.en: Short sentences can improve the readability of a report.
readability.zh: 短句可以提高报告的可读性。

informative.en: Informative programmes can be just as entertaining as other types of television.
informative.zh: 信息丰富的节目可以和其他类型的电视节目一样有趣。

correspondent.en: The newspaper's foreign correspondent reported directly from the war zone.
correspondent.zh: 这家报纸的驻外通讯记者从战区直接发回报道。

columnist.en: One columnist argued that the government should do more for young people.
columnist.zh: 一位专栏作家认为,政府应该为年轻人做更多事情。

editorial.en: An editorial in the national newspaper criticised the new tax.
editorial.zh: 全国性报纸的一篇社论批评了这项新税。

spokesman.en: A government spokesman denied that the policy would be changed.
spokesman.zh: 一位政府发言人否认这项政策会改变。

caricature.en: The newspaper printed a caricature of the prime minister on its front page.
caricature.zh: 这家报纸在头版刊登了一幅首相的讽刺漫画。

billboard.en: A large billboard beside the road can distract drivers and cause accidents.
billboard.zh: 路边的大广告牌可能分散司机的注意力,引发事故。

brainwashing.en: Some critics describe constant advertising as a form of brainwashing.
brainwashing.zh: 一些批评者把持续不断的广告说成是一种洗脑。

idol.en: Teenagers often copy the clothes and behaviour of their favourite idol.
idol.zh: 青少年常常模仿他们最喜欢的偶像的衣着和行为。

indulge.en: Parents who indulge their children may make it harder for them to cope later.
indulge.zh: 纵容孩子的父母可能让孩子日后更难应对问题。

pornography.en: Parents worry about their children finding pornography on the internet.
pornography.zh: 父母担心孩子在互联网上看到色情内容。

tempting.en: It is tempting for young people to buy things they cannot afford.
tempting.zh: 对年轻人来说,买自己负担不起的东西很诱人。

irresistible.en: Advertising can make unhealthy snacks seem irresistible to young children.
irresistible.zh: 广告能让不健康的零食对幼儿来说显得无法抗拒。

immature.en: Teenagers may be too immature to make such important decisions by themselves.
immature.zh: 青少年可能还太不成熟,无法独自作出如此重要的决定。

naive.en: It is naive to believe everything that appears on the internet.
naive.zh: 相信网上的一切是很天真的。

questionable.en: The company's claims about its environmental record are highly questionable.
questionable.zh: 该公司关于其环保记录的说法非常可疑。

alarming.en: The number of young people with mental health problems has reached alarming levels.
alarming.zh: 有心理健康问题的年轻人数量已达到令人担忧的水平。

disturbing.en: There is a disturbing rise in the amount of violence on television.
disturbing.zh: 电视上的暴力内容令人不安地增多了。

prevalence.en: The prevalence of mobile phones has changed how young people spend their time.
prevalence.zh: 手机的盛行改变了年轻人度过时间的方式。

blockbuster.en: A Hollywood blockbuster can earn more than the budget of a small country.
blockbuster.zh: 一部好莱坞大片的收入可能超过一个小国的预算。

premiere.en: The film's premiere attracted a large crowd of fans to the city.
premiere.zh: 这部电影的首映吸引了大批影迷来到这座城市。

trailer.en: A good trailer can persuade millions of people to see a film.
trailer.zh: 一部好的预告片能说服数百万人去看电影。

playwright.en: The playwright's works are still performed in theatres around the world.
playwright.zh: 这位剧作家的作品至今仍在世界各地的剧院上演。

musical.en: Tourists to London often go to see a musical during their stay.
musical.zh: 到伦敦的游客在逗留期间常常去看音乐剧。

climax.en: The climax of the film comes in the final fifteen minutes.
climax.zh: 这部电影的高潮出现在最后十五分钟。

applause.en: The audience gave the young actors a long round of applause.
applause.zh: 观众为年轻演员们报以长时间的掌声。

press-conference.en: The minister announced the new policy at a press conference this morning.
press-conference.zh: 部长今天上午在新闻发布会上宣布了新政策。

prime-time.en: Advertisements during prime time reach the largest number of viewers.
prime-time.zh: 黄金时段的广告能触达最多的观众。

best-seller.en: Her first novel became a best-seller in more than twenty countries.
best-seller.zh: 她的第一部小说在二十多个国家成为畅销书。

time-consuming.en: Filling in these official forms is a slow and time-consuming process.
time-consuming.zh: 填写这些官方表格是一个缓慢而耗时的过程。

forum.en: Online forums allow people with similar problems to share their experiences.
forum.zh: 网络论坛让有相似问题的人能够分享经验。

credibility.en: The newspaper lost its credibility after publishing several false stories.
credibility.zh: 这家报纸刊登了几篇虚假报道后失去了可信度。

clip.en: A short video clip can spread around the world within hours.
clip.zh: 一段短视频可能在几小时内传遍全球。

commentary.en: The programme included live commentary from two former players.
commentary.zh: 这个节目有两位前球员的现场解说。

messenger.en: Before the telephone, important news was carried by a messenger on horseback.
messenger.zh: 电话出现之前,重要消息由骑马的信使传递。

publicity.en: The company gained a great deal of publicity from the charity event.
publicity.zh: 这家公司通过这次慈善活动获得了大量宣传。

publication.en: The publication of the report led to a public debate on school meals.
publication.zh: 这份报告的发表引发了关于学校午餐的公众讨论。

fame.en: Many young people dream of fame and wealth as social media stars.
fame.zh: 许多年轻人梦想成为社交媒体明星,获得名声和财富。

pamphlet.en: The health department sent a pamphlet to every home in the region.
pamphlet.zh: 卫生部门向该地区每户家庭发送了一本小册子。
